scope: Acquire existing human-labeled data; do not create labels with synthetic generation or model consensus.

textRequirements.style: First-person description of a concrete recent or past Event; complete text; no truncation.
exclusions: social-platform text with unclear underlying rights
duplicates or paraphrases of COSO, RTN, canonical Train, or existing acquired rows

hardNegativeDefinition.required: For a target pair A/B, the existing human annotation must explicitly judge A applicable and B not applicable, or B applicable and A not applicable.
insufficient: B is merely omitted from a selective top-k label set
a model predicts A but not B
a single model rationale asserts B is absent

splitRules.COSOAndRTNOverlap: zero normalized text and zero source-group overlap
splitRules.selectionBlindness: Model-based acquisition ranking must be frozen before existing human labels are revealed.
